title: Wanda Aka Zaɓa
intro: A cikin inuwar dutse inda kalmomin allahntaka suka sauko, imanin mutane ya yi rauni a ƙarƙashin walƙiyar zinariya. Rai ɗaya, wanda aka bai wa baiwar iya magana, ya tsaya a matsayin goyon baya ga wani babban aiki, amma ya fuskanci lokacin gwaji mai zurfi. Lokacin da aka zaɓa manzon ya hau zuwa wani muhimmin alƙawari, wannan mutum ya tsaya a baya, yana roƙon al'umma mara natsuwa. Wacece wannan rai mai tawali'u wadda muryarta ta tashi a kan bautar gumaka?
clues: Allah ne ya zaɓe ni in zama annabi, kodayake labarina yakan kasance tare da wani.
An tura ni wurin wani azzalumin shugaba, amma aikina shine tallafawa, ba jagoranci ba.
Na sami baiwar iya magana, kuma kalmomina an yi su ne don tausasa zukata.
Lokacin da abokin tafiyata ya tafi wani muhimmin taro, sai na bar shi ya jagoranci mutane marasa natsuwa.
Cikin rashin haƙurinsu, sun ƙirƙira wani hoto daga kayan adon su, kuma na roƙe su da su ci gaba da kasancewa masu gaskiya ga Allah.
Abokina ya dawo ya kama ni, amma na yi masa bayani cewa mutanen sun fi ni ƙarfi sun kusa kashe ni; ban kasance cikin masu laifi ba.

arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
